fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the execution of well known tools that can be abused for data exfiltration and tunneling.
fields.name: Tunneling Tool Execution
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\httptunnel.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\plink.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\socat.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\stunnel.exe"))
